items.difficulty_reason: For f, g agreeing on the triple, take the equalizer E -> Y (monomorphism, locally quasi-finite); etale-locally Y is affine, E quasi-compact as a disjoint union over the affine open V and the affine closed V(f) x_X Y on both of which E -> Y is an isomorphism; Zariski's main theorem makes E quasi-affine; set B = Gamma(E), A = Gamma(Y) and use that E -> Y is iso after base change to U and X' to build ring maps B -> A_f, B -> A ⊗ R' agreeing into A ⊗ R'_f, hence by glueability of A a left inverse B -> A; the corresponding morphism Spec(A) -> Spec(B) lands in E (checked after base change) and E -> Y being a monomorphism forces Y -> E -> Y = id.
